snapshot_hole_serial_months.note: CME 6B lists serial months (S1 active chain = 24 consecutive monthly listings 2026-10..2028-09 + quarterly cycle to 2031-12; historical monthly listing of 2025-2026 serials is inferred from this pattern — POSTULATED), but the raw snapshot holds ZERO expired serial contracts: the data lane's expired_walk stepped quarterly only (S1 expired_walk months 202509,202506,202503,...). Consequence: the DECLARED literal roll rule (roll to next listed contract at last session before day-1 of expiry month) is NOT reconstructable from this snapshot for any roll whose target is a pre-Oct-2026 serial (6BZ5->6BF6 2025-11-28, 6BH6->6BJ6 2026-02-27, 6BM6->6BN6 2026-05-29 targets absent); the executable adaptation is the quarterly chain (roll quarterly->quarterly, consistent with measured liquidity: serials max 237 contracts/day RTH).
